label: Indonesia
short_description: Loyalty-program hotels across Indonesia -- Bali, Jakarta, Bandung, Yogyakarta, Solo, Surabaya, Lombok, and the Riau islands of Batam and Bintan.
intro: Indonesia's coverage in this directory spans the archipelago: Bali's beach and resort areas across the south of the island; the capital Jakarta and the cool highland city of Bandung in West Java; Yogyakarta and nearby Solo in Central Java; Surabaya, the East Java capital; the resort island of Lombok east of Bali; and the Riau Islands of Batam and Bintan, a short ferry from Singapore. Together they range from gated beach resorts and private islands to high-rise business and mall-linked city hotels.
